**Triage: `finding` admitted as class (a); lands in `eslint.config.js` (repo root, confirmed the only ESLint config on `origin/main`); rationale: the lint run reports a warning on a git-ignored build artefact nobody authored.**

⛔ Deliberately **not** folded into objectui#8369. That card fixes `scripts/check-lint-rule-coverage.mjs`'s census; it does not change what `eslint .` itself walks, and the card is explicit about that fence. Different file, different population — two cards.

### The measurement stands on its own controls

```
apps/console/plugin.d.ts   0 errors, 1 warning   @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any 41:17
apps/console/plugin.js     0 errors, 0 warnings
apps/site/next-env.d.ts    0 errors, 0 warnings
```

⭐ The two zeros are what make the 1 a reading rather than a broken invocation — the same command in the same run answered both ways. All three are build output, git-ignored, absent from `HEAD`, produced by `turbo run build`.

⇒ the population ESLint walks should exclude generated output. ⚠️ Note the consequence for whoever takes it: this warning is only visible **after** a build, so a clean checkout will not reproduce it — run `turbo run build` first or the probe will show nothing and read as fixed.

⛔ Do not silence it with an inline disable in the generated file: the file is regenerated, so the suppression would vanish on the next build and the card would return.

`Size/model suggestion:` S, mechanical — an ignore-population change, with the build-first caveat above as the acceptance condition.
